    JOIN zigcho.beatmaps b ON b.md5=s.map_md5
    JOIN zigcho.users u ON u.id=s.user_id
    WHERE s.mode=$2 AND s.rank_namespace=$3
      AND s.passed AND s.best AND b.status IN($5,$6) AND NOT u.restricted
    UNION ALL
    SELECT s.id, s.user_id, b.id AS beatmap_key, s.total_score AS score,
           s.pp, $7::text AS client, s.submitted_at
    FROM zigcho.lazer_scores s
    JOIN zigcho.beatmaps b ON b.id=s.beatmap_id
    JOIN zigcho.users u ON u.id=s.user_id
    WHERE s.ruleset_id=$2 AND s.rank_namespace=$3
      AND s.passed AND s.best AND b.status IN($8,$9) AND NOT u.restricted
), per_user AS (
    SELECT *, row_number() OVER (
        PARTITION BY user_id,beatmap_key ORDER BY pp DESC,CASE client WHEN $10 THEN $11 ELSE $12 END,id ASC

), board AS (
    SELECT *, row_number() OVER (

-- Rank only narrow keys. Display metadata and replay checks belong after LIMIT.
WITH candidates AS (
    SELECT s.id, s.user_id, b.id AS beatmap_key, s.score AS score,
           s.pp, $4::text AS client, s.submitted_at
    FROM zigcho.scores s
    JOIN zigcho.beatmaps b ON b.md5=s.map_md5
    JOIN zigcho.users u ON u.id=s.user_id
    WHERE s.mode=$2 AND s.rank_namespace=$3
      AND s.passed AND s.best AND b.status IN($5,$6) AND NOT u.restricted
    UNION ALL
    SELECT s.id, s.user_id, b.id AS beatmap_key, s.total_score AS score,
           s.pp, $7::text AS client, s.submitted_at
    FROM zigcho.lazer_scores s
    JOIN zigcho.beatmaps b ON b.id=s.beatmap_id
    JOIN zigcho.users u ON u.id=s.user_id
    WHERE s.ruleset_id=$2 AND s.rank_namespace=$3
      AND s.passed AND s.best AND b.status IN($8,$9) AND NOT u.restricted
), per_user AS (
    SELECT *, row_number() OVER (
        PARTITION BY user_id,beatmap_key ORDER BY pp DESC,CASE client WHEN $10 THEN $11 ELSE $12 END,id ASC
    ) AS user_place FROM candidates
), board AS (
    SELECT *, row_number() OVER (
        PARTITION BY beatmap_key ORDER BY score DESC,CASE client WHEN $13 THEN $14 ELSE $15 END,id ASC
    ) AS map_place FROM per_user WHERE user_place=$16
), firsts AS (
    SELECT *, count(*) OVER () AS first_count FROM board WHERE map_place=$17 AND user_id=$1
), picked AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT * FROM firsts ORDER BY submitted_at DESC,client ASC,id DESC LIMIT $18
), hydrated AS (
    SELECT s.id, s.score AS score, s.pp, s.accuracy, s.max_combo,
           s.mods AS mods, s.mode AS mode, s.rank_namespace, s.passed, s.submitted_at,
           b.set_id, b.id AS map_id, b.artist, b.title, b.version, b.status,
           p.client, $19::text AS mods_json,
           s.passed AND (coalesce(octet_length(s.replay),$20)>$21 OR EXISTS(
               SELECT $22 FROM zigcho.replay_objects ro WHERE ro.source=$23 AND ro.score_id=s.id
           )) AS has_replay,
           coalesce(nullif(s.star_rating,$24),b.star_
